resources.string:
My new Scripture search app is a powerful tool that will help you explore the Bible in depth and find the verses you need. Whether you want to study a specific topic, this app has it all.
With my app, you can:
- Search for any keyword or reference - Share verses with friends via social media, email, or text - Access thousands of reading plans and devotionals to grow in your faith
My app is easy to use!
My app is based on bible-api.com, one of the most popular online Bible tools. It also integrates with other apps like YouVersion and Bible Search! for more features and options.
My app is designed to help you seek and find God's Word in a new way. Download it today and discover how it can transform your personal Bible study.
My site uses bible-api.com to provide a JSON API for grabbing bible verses and passages. You can lookup scripture by using this format: BOOK+CHAPTER:VERSE. You can also specify different translations, verse numbers, and ranges using query parameters. For more details, please visit bible-api.com or check out their GitHub repository.
: https://github.com/seven1m/bible_api
